name: social_publisher
description: Autonomous multi-platform video publisher (YouTube, TikTok, Douyin, Bilibili, Instagram, WeChat Channels) powered by patchright anti-detect browser automation.

action.description: Operation to perform: upload_video, check_status, or login.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the video file to upload.

title.description: Title of the video (max 100 chars for YouTube/TikTok).

tags.description: List of tags or hashtags without leading '#'.

thumbnail.description: Optional absolute path to custom cover/thumbnail image.

schedule.description: Optional scheduled publication timestamp in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' format.
